data.body:
Security and protection extensions retain declarations, obligations and representation choices. Their presence in a schema does not authenticate an actor or establish permission.

Consumer runtimes must supply trusted subjects, current policy state and operation-specific evidence. Unknown security content cannot authorize execution. Field protection, private computation and disclosure transport keep their distinct native prerequisites.

Inspect both security extension versions and protection schemas. Follow their allocated evidence and unresolved prerequisites instead of assuming a broad security-support badge.
